preconditions.expression: all(c in '()' for c in stdin)
preconditions.description: The input string contains only '(' and ')' characters.
The length of the input string does not exceed 10^6.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '0 1' or (len(stdout.split()) == 2 and stdout.split()[0].isdigit() and stdout.split()[1].isdigit())
postconditions.description: The output is either '0 1' or two space-separated integers.
If the output is not '0 1', the first integer is greater than 0.
If the output is not '0 1', the second integer is greater than 0.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '0 1' or all(len(sub) == int(stdout.split()[0]) for sub in find_longest_regular_substrings(stdin))
postconditions.description: If the output is not '0 1', all longest regular substrings have the length specified in the output.
If the output is not '0 1', the number of longest regular substrings matches the count specified in the output.
